root_cause: The mobile language control used two custom side-by-side buttons. The requested reference behavior uses one compact menu row backed by the browser's native select control, which on iOS opens the familiar system language chooser with a checkmark next to the active option.
prevention: Mobile language switching should use a native select control inside the menu so iOS and other browsers provide the expected native chooser interaction.
The mobile selector must remain in the menu, never float above content or WhatsApp.
The native select value must stay synchronized with bg_locale and delegated locale changes.
Desktop may retain its compact custom dropdown; the mobile interaction follows the native selector pattern.
evidence: user reference screenshot 2026-09-21 showing neno.co native English/Dutch chooser
